title: Tamed Mount: Turtle
text: Mount Grand Grand Ferocious Turtle Slow to start, impossible to stop once that shell opens for war. The Tamed Turtle has the following skills: Lv10: Run!Run!Instant30sec CooldownIncreases Move Speed +80%, then gradually decreases it over 10sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv20: Wild ChargeWild ChargeInstant30sec CooldownCharges forward for 3sec, breaking through enemy lines. Inflicts Knockback and Trip on affected enemies. This skill counts as a Push effect. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv30: Powerful BlowPowerful BlowInstant30sec CooldownDecreases the target's Attack Speed -300. or OverwhelmOverwhelmInstant10sec Cooldown[Pet Skill] Overwhelm Lv40: Ocean SongOcean SongInstant45sec CooldownDecreases Attack -30% of enemies within a 4m radius. Can't be used while under the effect of Run! or Wild Charge. or SlamSlamInstant15sec CooldownStrikes an enemy with a strong blow, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and inflicting Stun for 1sec. Right-click to activate auto-use. Lv50: Protecting ShellProtecting ShellInstant1min CooldownGrants the Turtle's Protection to both the rider and the mount, which reduces 99% of incoming Damage for 3sec. Decreases Move Speed -50% while the effect lasts. or Vicious BiteVicious BiteInstant18sec CooldownStrikes a distant target, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and an additional (varies) damage over 14sec. Can't be used while charging, airborne, or carrying a trade pack. Use: Summons a mount.
